title: SwiftFit - AI Fitness Pro
challenge: A local fitness studio wanted to digitise their form correction process using AI but existing apps were too generic and expensive.
solution: We developed a cross-platform app using Flutter with a custom TensorFlow Lite model that provides real-time form feedback on-device.
outcome: Users reported a 40% increase in form accuracy. The studio saw 10k downloads in the first month, boosting recurring revenue by 22%.

title: Score Your Run
challenge: Local matches were manually recorded on paper, leading to delays and errors in tournament stats and player leaderboards.
solution: We built 'Score Your Run', a fast, offline-first scoring app that syncs data to a global leaderboard as soon as connectivity is found.
outcome: Digitised 100+ tournament matches last season. Parents and fans can now follow live ball-by-ball updates via the app.

title: CityRide Taxi App
challenge: A local taxi fleet was losing business to giants because they had no digital way for customers to see car availability or book instantly.
solution: We created a driver-passenger ecosystem with real-time GPS tracking and automated dispatch algorithms tailored for local zones.
outcome: Operational across a fleet of 100 taxis. Booking volume increased by 30% and average passenger wait time fell to 6 minutes.

title: Cyber Spy Utility
challenge: Privacy advocates needed a mobile tool to audit app permissions and detect hidden background trackers on personal devices.
solution: We developed 'Cyber Spy', a lightweight utility that visualizes app data exfiltration attempts and ranks device vulnerability.
outcome: Helping 5,000+ users monitor their digital privacy. Successfully identified and flagged several malicious background processes.

title: Shanti Global Portal
challenge: An international export vendor lacked a digital storefront that could showcase their product catalogue reliably to global buyers across timezones.
solution: We built a high-performance web portal with multi-language support, a dynamic product inventory, and an automated inquiry system.
outcome: Enabled seamless inquiries from 12 countries. Catalogue management time reduced by 60% and lead generation increased by 35%.

title: Lumina Academy LMS
challenge: Lumina needed a student-friendly LMS to deliver niche professional courses that emphasized video quality and progress tracking.
solution: We custom-built a Next.js LMS with low-latency video delivery, automated quizzes, and a gamified student dashboard.
outcome: Achieved a 90% completion rate for active students. The platform now supports over 2,000 active learners monthly.

title: AutoAssist Chatbot
challenge: A service provider was overwhelmed by repetitive support inquiries, taking hours away from their specialized case work.
solution: We deployed a custom GPT-powered chatbot integrated with their specialized knowledge base to handle context-aware support in real-time.
outcome: Successfully resolved 80% of support queries automatically. Response time fell from 4 hours to under 10 seconds.

title: RAG Langchain Pipeline
challenge: A legal research firm needed to extract specific data from thousands of PDF documents without manual keyword searches.
solution: We built a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline using Langchain and Vector Embeddings to provide factual answers from local PDF corpora.
outcome: Search efficiency increased by 95%. Analysts now query their entire documentation library using natural language.

title: IntelliDeploy CI/CD
challenge: Frequent deployment failures due to edge-case environment variables and missing dependency checks were costing the agency significant time.
solution: An intelligent CI/CD pipeline using AI models to predict potential deployment conflicts and auto-remediate configuration errors.
outcome: Achieved a 99.9% deployment success rate. Deployment time fell from 45 minutes to 12 minutes per environment.

title: Promofy Multi-Vendor
challenge: Traditional wholesalers lacked a way to list their products for local shop owners to order outside of phone calls.
solution: We launched 'Promofy', a comprehensive multi-vendor marketplace with vendor dashboards, inventory management, and regional delivery tracking.
outcome: Onboarded 50 global-scale vendors in its first quarter. Daily order processing is now 100% automated.

title: Luxe Mart Storefront
challenge: A high-end retail brand had an outdated WooCommerce site that failed to represent their premium brand aesthetic and had a confusing checkout.
solution: A custom headless ecommerce storefront using Next.js and Shopify, focusing on ultra-minimalist design and a 2-step checkout process.
outcome: Mobile conversion rate doubled. Site load time dropped below 1 second, significantly reducing bounce rates.

title: QuickShop Local
challenge: A local mart needed a simple way for elders to book grocery deliveries without navigating complex apps.
solution: A hyper-simplified mobile app with voice-assisted search and 1-tap ordering for recurring items.
outcome: Handling over 200 orders daily. The app saw a 85% retention rate among users aged 50+.

title: SEO Growth Campaign
challenge: A network of dental clinics was invisible on local search, losing leads to competitors with modern search presence.
solution: We executed a data-driven local SEO strategy and content cluster campaign focused on high-intent local dental keywords.
outcome: Clinics now rank #1 for their top 5 local keywords. Lead volume increased by 300% from organic search alone.

title: AdMax PPC Strategy
challenge: The brand was bleeding budget on generic keywords without any attribution tracking, leading to high CAC and low transparency.
solution: A complete overhaul of their PPC and Meta ads strategy using highly targeted remarketing lists and automated bidding.
outcome: Achieved a sustained 4.5x ROAS. Reduced CPA by 40% while doubling total monthly sales volume.

title: Small Office ERP
challenge: Paper-based tracking of manufacturing orders was causing lost data and miscommunication between office and workshop.
solution: A lightweight web ERP system tailored to their specific assembly-line workflow with real-time status updates.
outcome: Zero lost orders in six months. Communication efficiency improved by 80%. Staff training took only 3 days.

title: Zenith CRM System
challenge: Lead tracking in fragmented spreadsheets lead to zero follow-ups and missed growth targets for the sales team.
solution: A custom CRM dashboard with automated follow-up sequences and a clear visual pipeline for lead management.
outcome: Increased sales velocity by 20%. The team now spends 50% less time on administration and more time on high-value calls.
